gloss: from the standpoint of; in terms of; on

definitions.gloss: from the standpoint of; in terms of; as far as ... is concerned
definitions.explanation: Attached to a Sino-Japanese noun to name the perspective from which a statement holds: {法律上|ほうりつじょう} (legally speaking), {仕事上|しごとじょう} (in the course of work). Common in formal writing and business speech.

examples.japanese: {法律上|ほうりつじょう}の{問題|もんだい}はない。
{仕事上|しごとじょう}のつきあいで{飲|の}みに{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went out drinking as a work obligation.

examples.japanese: {性質上|せいしつじょう}、この{薬|くすり}は{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}で{保管|ほかん}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: By its nature, this medicine must be kept in the refrigerator.

examples.japanese: {予算上|よさんじょう}の{制約|せいやく}があるため、{今年度|こんねんど}は{新|あたら}しい{機械|きかい}を{買|か}えない。
examples.english: Because of budgetary constraints, we cannot buy new machinery this fiscal year.

notes:
Attaches directly to a Sino-Japanese noun with no particle. The resulting word behaves as a noun: it takes の before another noun ({法律上|ほうりつじょう}の{問題|もんだい}) and can stand adverbially at the head of a clause ({性質上|せいしつじょう}、…).

COMMON COMBINATIONS:
- {仕事上|しごとじょう}: in the course of work
- {法律上|ほうりつじょう}: legally, in legal terms
- {健康上|けんこうじょう}: for health reasons
- {計算上|けいさんじょう}: by calculation, on paper
- {都合上|つごうじょう}: for reasons of convenience or circumstance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- 〜{的|てき}に: -ally — attaches more freely and is far less formal
- 〜{面|めん}で: in the aspect of — points to one facet among several rather than a viewpoint
